answer: A saddler's harness stitching stops Sybils in the delta trade. A newcomer stitches 16 harnesses over 28 days. Each harness's 300 stitches are counted and pull-tested by 2 saddlers from different workshops, then logged. One harness with over 4 loose stitches voids its credit and freezes rewards 14 days; 3 loose ones void the whole tally. Faking 1,000 agents means 16,000 harnesses, 4.8 million stitches, 32,000 checks, a bridge no forger crosses, while honest work passes marble-smooth through every check. Trust comes stitch by stitch, the way a river carves its delta.
